policy: References informed taxonomy, adult size, armor, body proportions, appendage layout and colour placement only. No source pixels were sampled, traced, copied, hotlinked or redistributed.
taxonomyNote: Corydoras aeneus is retained as the familiar aquarium-trade label. FishBase record 7777 currently presents the accepted combination Osteogaster aenea and lists Corydoras aeneus as a synonym; this source-only refinement does not change the stable game identifier.

sources.title: Osteogaster aenea (Gill, 1858), Bronze corydoras, species summary record 7777
sources.author: Rainer Froese and Daniel Pauly, editors
sources.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 for FishBase text and data; contributed images retain their own licenses
evidenceCues: Maximum length is 7.5 cm standard length and body height is 2.5 to 2.9 times in standard length.
The snout is short and rounded, with one dorsal spine, seven dorsal soft rays, 23 to 24 dorsal plates and 20 to 22 ventral plates.
The pectoral spine is long and internally denticulated; fins are yellow or pink without strong markings.
A brownish-orange predorsal patch is particularly visible from above.

sources.title: File:Female Bronze Corydoras (Corydoras aeneus).jpg
sources.author: Andrew Keller
sources.provenance: Author's own work, photographed 12 October 2020 and released by the copyright holder under CC0.
evidenceCues: Deep armored shoulder and trunk taper sharply into a narrow caudal peduncle.
The dorsal roof rises over the pectoral girdle, then slopes continuously to the short rounded snout.
The belly is distinctly flatter than the dorsal outline and the mouth sits below the snout axis.
The flank carries a dark olive-bronze field over a pale lower body; the fins remain translucent amber.

sources.title: File:Corydoras aeneus barbels.jpg
sources.author: Ude
sources.provenance: Author's own work, photographed and uploaded 29 December 2010.
sources.license: CC BY-SA 3.0 or GNU Free Documentation License 1.2 or later
evidenceCues: The broad armored cheeks narrow into a short snout; the eyes are embedded laterally instead of projecting as beads.
The inferior mouth is a small transverse opening beneath the snout, not a circular terminal sucker.
Long maxillary barbels taper from the mouth corners and shorter lower barbels originate beneath the mouth.
The underside is flattened relative to the arched head roof.

sources.title: File:Corydoras aeneus 32182319.jpg
sources.author: karsten_s
sources.view: wild specimen in Suriname, oblique lateral context
sources.provenance: Original iNaturalist photograph from Suriname, 27 September 2016; license reviewed by INaturalistReviewBot before the Commons import.
evidenceCues: Wild colour is muted olive-bronze rather than uniform tan or saturated gold.
The head and pectoral girdle are robust while the posterior body and peduncle taper visibly.
Foreshortening and field posture prohibit calibrated width measurements.

sources.title: Descriptive osteology of Corydoras aeneus (Siluriformes: Callichthyidae)
sources.author: Frank Huysentruyt and Dominique Adriaens
sources.view: dorsal, ventral and lateral adult skull drawings plus fin and girdle osteology
sources.license: No Creative Commons image-reuse license stated; no figures were copied or redistributed
evidenceCues: The adult neurocranium is pyriform, narrow anteriorly and broadening posteriorly, which supports a short narrow snout leading into broader cheeks.
The dorsal skull view constrains the head roof qualitatively but does not calibrate live whole-body width.
The infraorbitals, opercle and pectoral girdle form substantial armor plates.
The adipose fin includes a spine derived from a dorsal bony plate.

sources.title: How to look after freshwater catfish
sources.author: Ornamental Aquatic Trade Association Ltd
sources.license: Copyright OATA; no open reuse license stated
evidenceCues: Corydoras are shoaling catfish with sensitive head barbels and strong front pectoral spines.
This husbandry source is not used to calibrate body proportions or coloration.

viewCoverage.side: Strong: exact live-fish file pages plus FishBase proportions and meristics constrain the outline and fin placement.
viewCoverage.front: Strong for the head, inferior mouth and barbel origins: an exact licensed frontal file page is available.
viewCoverage.top: Partial: peer-reviewed dorsal skull anatomy and the FishBase predorsal colour note constrain the head roof, but no verified live whole-body orthographic top photograph was found.
viewCoverage.bodyWidth: Moderate uncertainty: live soft-tissue width is inferred from the frontal head photograph, pyriform skull description and lateral body depth. It is not claimed as a calibrated measurement.

referenceGradeRationale: Authoritative morphology plus exact lateral and frontal originals strongly constrain body depth, head, mouth, barbels, armor and fins. Whole-body top width remains uncalibrated, so the source does not claim orthographic top-view acceptance.
